title: AI Anti-Deepfake KYC Agent: Armor Your B2B Onboarding and Prevent Synthetic Identity Fraud
body:
Is your B2B platform approving fake accounts created with Artificial Intelligence?

Synthetic identity fraud has evolved. Small fintechs, investment platforms, and corporate SaaS are suffering an avalanche of attacks with video "deepfakes" and cloned audio during the Know Your Customer (KYC) process. Manually validating every video or ID document with a human team not only slows down the onboarding of legitimate clients, but it is also ineffective against AI-generated forgeries that the human eye can no longer detect. The result: massive chargebacks, money laundering, and regulatory fines that can bankrupt your business.

The trap of Standard KYC APIs

Most SMEs resort to commercial verification gateways that charge exorbitant commissions for every attempt (even failed ones), or depend on static facial verifications that are easily bypassed with a device in front of the camera. Outsourced flat-rate security is eating your margins and letting professional scammers in.

Our solution: High-Performance Anti-Deepfake KYC AI Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we do not depend on third-party gateways that hijack your data. We deploy an Artificial Intelligence Agent specialized in biometric analysis and liveness detection directly into your Cloud infrastructure. Our model analyzes micro-expressions, pixel inconsistencies, and thermal anomalies in the video spectrum in milliseconds, cross-referencing the corporate client's commercial data without friction.

  1. Real-Time Liveness Analysis: The AI Agent audits the user's video looking for compression artifacts typical of deepfakes and synthetic blinking.
  2. B2B OCR and Holographic Verification: We automatically extract and validate tax identification data, cross-referencing them with government databases instantly.
  3. Zero-Trust Architecture: All verification happens on isolated servers to strictly comply with the GDPR, without sending faces or documents to unencrypted public clouds.
  4. Automatic Blocking and Quarantine: If it detects a fraud pattern, the bot blocks the IP, suspends the activation webhook, and notifies your compliance team via an internal Telegram bot.

The Real Impact on your Compliance Department

  • 99% Reduction in Synthetic Fraud: Filter out automated attackers before they generate fraudulent payments in your Stripe production environment.
  • B2B Onboarding in 3 Seconds: Your legitimate corporate clients will not wait days for a manual validation, skyrocketing your conversion rate.
  • 80% Savings in Verification Costs: Pay only for the computing cost of your own AI, eliminating the abusive tolls of traditional KYC monopolies.
